description: Source code for validating the 'bsln' table in TrueTypeGX/AAT font tables within the FreeType project. Contains functions for table validation, data structures, and validation routines for different table formats.

methods.name: gxv_bsln_LookupValue_validate
methods.description: Validates a lookup value for the 'bsln' table, ensuring it is within valid range and not empty.

methods.name: gxv_bsln_LookupFmt4_transit
methods.description: Translates a relative glyph index into a lookup value in format 4 of the 'bsln' table.

methods.name: gxv_bsln_parts_fmt0_validate
methods.description: Validates parts of the 'bsln' table in format 0.

methods.name: gxv_bsln_parts_fmt1_validate
methods.description: Validates parts of the 'bsln' table in format 1, including lookup data.

methods.name: gxv_bsln_parts_fmt2_validate
methods.description: Validates parts of the 'bsln' table in format 2, including glyph and control point validation.

methods.name: gxv_bsln_parts_fmt3_validate
methods.description: Validates parts of the 'bsln' table in format 3, combining format 2 validation and lookup data.

methods.name: gxv_bsln_validate
methods.description: Main validation function for the 'bsln' table, dispatching to format-specific validation routines.
